findings.target_leakage: G3 excluded from all features and support heuristics; earlier grades only updated.
findings.preprocessing: All imputers/encoders/scalers fit inside each training CV fold; final fit 389 training rows.
findings.separation: 389 train, 130 calibration, 130 test, no shared row indices. Same fixed splits as Phase 1.
findings.test_reuse: Historical test already examined in Phase 1. No selection on this test, but not a fresh independent confirmation.
findings.validation: Five-fold training CV for all candidates, one-standard-error simplicity heuristic; folds correlated so SE is not a formal significance test.
findings.baseline_gap_fixed: Early mean/median; updated G2 persistence and G1/G2-only linear added beside mean/median.
findings.timing: Questionnaire timing cannot prove prospective early availability. Full-year absences excluded.
findings.input_support: Strict domain/schema rejection plus training-only active-feature support and nearest-neighbor warning heuristic.
findings.unresolved: No student IDs or temporal/external cohort. Random row split cannot establish independence, transportability or fairness.

interpretation: Early coarse background predictors contain limited information without prior grades. Ridge does not materially improve CV error; complexity is not justified. Target-band residuals are descriptive and were not used for tuning.
